name: 10 — Tool failure recovery (SSRF block, then continue)
description: Agent asks the orchestrator to web_scrape a private IP (which is blocked by SSRF protection). The orchestrator must emit a tool_result with success=false, continue to the next iteration, and complete the session normally. Verifies that a single failed tool call does not terminate the session and that the failure surfaces through the SSE stream.
prompt: Try to retrieve content from the internal status page, then summarize what you learned.

llmResponses.thinking: I'll try to fetch the internal status page first.
The scrape was blocked because that's a private IP. I'll summarize what happened and finish.

blackboardUpdates.title: Outcome
blackboardUpdates.content: The internal status URL is on a private IP (10.0.0.1) and the SSRF guard blocked the scrape. No content was retrieved. Recommend the user provide a publicly reachable URL or grant the necessary internal-network access.

llmResponses.userMessage: Couldn't reach internal IP; reported the SSRF block.
